lines.text: What's this cell carrying? Room for about a billion passengers.
lines.phonemes: wˌɒts ðɪs sˈɛl kˈaɹiɪŋ? ɹˈuːm fɔːɹ ɐbˌaʊt ɐ bˈɪliən pˈasɪndʒəz.

lines.text: It's stuffed with one protein, hemoglobin: about a quarter of a billion copies. Each one has four iron seats, and each seat holds one oxygen.
lines.phonemes: ɪts stˈʌft wɪð wˈɒn pɹˈəʊtiːn, hˌiːməɡlˈəʊbɪn: ɐbˌaʊt ɐ kwˈɔːtəɹ əvə bˈɪliən kˈɒpɪz. ˈiːtʃ wˈɒn hɐz fˈɔːɹ ˈaɪən sˈiːts, and ˈiːtʃ sˈiːt hˈəʊldz wˈɒn ˈɒksɪdʒən.

lines.text: Watch one fill. The first oxygen struggles to get on, but each one makes the next one easier. Empty, it's dark red; full, it's bright red.
lines.phonemes: wˈɒtʃ wˈɒn fˈɪl. ðə fˈɜːst ˈɒksɪdʒən stɹˈʌɡəlz tə ɡɛt ˈɒn, bˌʌt ˈiːtʃ wˈɒn mˌeɪks ðə nˈɛkst wˈɒn ˈiːziə. ˈɛmpti, ɪts dˈɑːk ɹˈɛd; fˈʊl, ɪts bɹˈaɪt ɹˈɛd.

lines.text: Veins often look blue, so it's easy to guess the blood inside is too. It never is. Blood heading home is darker red. Red light sinks in, the vein swallows it, so less red bounces back.
lines.phonemes: vˈeɪnz ˈɒfən lˈʊk blˈuː, sˌəʊ ɪts ˈiːzi tə ɡˈɛs ðə blˈʌd ɪnsˈaɪd ɪz tˈuː. ɪt nˈɛvəɹ ɪz. blˈʌd hˈɛdɪŋ hˈəʊm ɪz dˈɑːkə ɹˈɛd. ɹˈɛd lˈaɪt sˈɪŋks ˈɪn, ðə vˈeɪn swˈɒləʊz ɪt, sˌəʊ lˈɛs ɹˈɛd bˈaʊnsɪz bˈak.

lines.text: Your heart sends your blood back through your lungs about once a minute. There, the empty seats fill. In about a quarter of a second.
lines.phonemes: jɔː hˈɑːt sˈɛndz jɔː blˈʌd bˈak θɹuː jɔː lˈʌŋz ɐbˌaʊt wˈʌns ɐ mˈɪnɪt. ðˈeə, ðɪ ˈɛmpti sˈiːts fˈɪl. ɪn ɐbˌaʊt ɐ kwˈɔːtəɹ əvə sˈɛkənd.

lines.text: The blue is your skin's trick. The red is a passenger count: brighter means fuller seats.
lines.phonemes: ðə blˈuː ɪz jɔː skˈɪnz tɹˈɪk. ðə ɹˈɛd ɪz ɐ pˈasɪndʒə kˈaʊnt: bɹˈaɪtə mˈiːnz fˈʊlə sˈiːts.

lines.text: Meanwhile, as you watched, your blood handed your body about a cup of oxygen.
lines.phonemes: mˈiːnwaɪl, az juː wˈɒtʃt, jɔː blˈʌd hˈandɪd jɔː bˈɒdi ɐbˌaʊt ɐ kˈʌp ɒv ˈɒksɪdʒən.

lines.text: Next: the signal in your nerves. In the fastest, it doesn't crawl; it jumps.
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: ðə sˈɪɡnəl ɪn jɔː nˈɜːvz. ɪnðə fˈastɪst, ɪt dˈʌzənt kɹˈɔːl; ɪt dʒˈʌmps.
